doc.description: Weight and center of gravity from load cells in the landing gear. Load cells are received over uavcan (pprz.equipment.loadcell.Measurement) and optionally from one ADS1220 connected to an SPI bus of the autopilot (configure WEIGHT_BALANCE_SPI_DEV). Each wheel is mapped to a load cell id, from the wheel forces the total mass and the CG position in the body frame are computed and sent in the WEIGHT_BALANCE module message (add it to the telemetry XML of the aircraft). Calibrate by setting the offsets with the wheels unloaded (tare) and then placing a known mass on each wheel (calibrate), and copy the resulting values to the airframe file.

configure.name: WEIGHT_BALANCE_SPI_DEV
configure.description: SPI bus of a local ADS1220 (optional), spi6 is the external SPI port of the Pixhawk 6X

configure.name: WEIGHT_BALANCE_SPI_SLAVE_IDX
configure.description: SPI slave select of a local ADS1220, 7 is CS1 of the external SPI port of the Pixhawk 6X

define.name: WHEEL_X
define.description: Wheel contact point in body frame, forward

define.name: WHEEL_Y
define.description: Wheel contact point in body frame, right

define.name: WHEEL_OFFSET
define.description: Load cell reading without load per wheel [counts]

define.name: CG_HEIGHT
define.description: Height of the CG above the wheel contact plane, for attitude correction

define.name: TIMEOUT
define.description: Maximum age of a load cell reading

define.name: MIN_FORCE
define.description: Minimum total force to compute the CG

define.name: CG_X_MIN
define.description: Preflight check: minimum CG x (optional, with CG_X_MAX)

define.name: CG_X_MAX
define.description: Preflight check: maximum CG x (optional, with CG_X_MIN)

define.name: CG_Y_MAX
define.description: Preflight check: maximum absolute CG y (optional)

define.name: ADS1220_ID
define.description: Load cell id of the local ADS1220

define.name: ADS1220_MUX
define.description: Bridge input of the local ADS1220

define.name: ADS1220_CUTOFF
define.description: Low-pass cutoff of the local ADS1220, 0 to disable
